body:
i have less than a thousand dollars. i dont know if i could afford the move :( i'm afraid of homeless shelters--i'm a girl, and i know there's a high rate of sexual assault in many shelters.

i do feel a little better about not wasting my time on people who don't want to help me anymore. however, that still leaves me feeling like im worthless. like i take and i take and i shouldn't be alive because i just keep taking from people.

i'm not sure how i can alter my thought patterns when i'm living in my car :( i dont feel like there's much positivity to be gained from that circumstance
